messages:
dan.support: FYI — SprocketCo trial account is spiking. Since 09:00 UTC we've seen a ~3x jump in request rate and a bunch of 429s + a couple timeouts. They're onboarding heavy embedding jobs. Support applied temporary rate limits to keep the cluster healthy. Escalating to CS because this is a trial w/ renewal risk. @maria.csm can you own comms?

maria.csm: Thanks @dan.support. Oof. Quick Qs — did they hit quota or backend throttling? Any errors we can share with them? We should propose a short enablement call and offer a temporary quota bump if infra approves. :handshake:

ops-bot: alert: rate_limit_policy_triggered customer_id=sprocket-42 policy=ingest-default window=60s spikes=3

alex.eng: Logs show per-second ingest spike and KV cache thrash. We're returning 429s from the ingest service (ingest-v2). If CS wants a bump, we can add +25% quota for 2 hours while we watch, but need signoff from infra. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/ingest-throttle

jamie.csops: I'll draft a quick comms template. Suggest: short acknowledgement, cause = onboarding spike, temporary steps we're taking (rate-limit + monitoring), options: 1) enablement call, 2) temporary quota bump, 3) best-practice guide + batching snippet. Want to include a one-click meeting link.

maria.csm: Draft please. Customer likely sensitive — trial and tight timeline. I'll do call if they accept. Proposed reply (short):
"Hi Team — thanks for flagging. We've temporarily limited ingest to protect overall performance. We can (a) schedule a 30m enablement to optimize batching, or (b) grant a short quota bump while we observe. Which would you prefer? —Maria"

dan.support: customer said they started a backfill job this morning and pointed to a script that fires parallel uploads. They didn't use batching. Sending snippet they ran: ```for f in files/*; do curl -X POST /v1/ingest -d @"$f" & done```

alex.eng: Yep that's parallel hammering. Best-practice snippet to share: ```xargs -P 4 -I{} curl -X POST /v1/ingest -d @{} < <(printf "%s\n" files/*)``` and recommend batching 50 docs per request.

maria.csm: Perfect. @jamie.csops can you include that in the email and add the temporary bump option? I'll send once approved. Ops/infra people: please confirm quota bump and window.

jamie.csops: Drafted email and a short invite template. Attaching in thread (paste):
"Hi Sprocket team — saw the ingestion burst. We've applied temporary protection to keep your trial stable. Two quick options: (1) 30m enablement to walk batching + rate patterns, (2) +25% quota for 2 hours while you run backfill with batching. If you want option 2, reply YES and we'll provision now. Otherwise pick a time for option 1. — Maria (CSM)"

ops-bot: infra-request-created id=ir-87345 type=quota-bump requester=maria.csm amount=25% duration=2h status=pending

alex.eng: I'll monitor and stand by to roll a config tweak if needed. Putting alert watch on the ingestion service for next 3 hours.

maria.csm: Action items: (1) jamie send email template to me:done, (2) ops approve bump: pending, (3) dan follow up w/ customer to get explicit choice, (4) alex watch metrics and rollback if errors reoccur. I'll update thread after customer reply.

dan.support: I'll ping them now and ask to choose. ETA reply ~30m.

jamie.csops: capturing feedback: ask them how they discovered batch vs parallel and whether onboarding docs were followed. We'll add that to the onboarding checklist if it's missing.

maria.csm: Thanks team — keeping this P1 for CS. I'll loop in AM if no reply in 45m. :eyes:
